name: X1: the queued new SELL is booked onto the desk's rows again
X2: the queued Correction is written onto its row again
X3: a queued trade is not counted as waiting
X4: a queued count is taken for a trade
X5: the bar says nothing of the queued trades
X6: the queue panel says every entry is in the figures again
find: A count, a loss or a loan is in every figure on the desk until it is committed to the ledger; a queued trade counts in no figure until the Book holds it.
replace: These are already folded into every figure on the desk until they are committed to the ledger.

name: X7: a second applier is back on the page
X8: the trade count is not reset between passes
